# Consolidation Exercises {.unnumbered}

These exercises revisit the adventure's skills on a different page. Use the archived version of the IMDb Top 250 Movies page: <https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/>

1. Read the HTML page with `read_html()`.
2. Locate the sections containing movie titles with `html_elements()`.
3. Extract titles with the `.titleColumn a` selector.
4. Extract years with the `.titleColumn span` selector.
5. Extract ratings with the `.imdbRating strong` selector.
6. Combine the three vectors into a `data.frame`.
7. Check IMDb's `robots.txt` file and explain why this check is not sufficient on its own.
